component.name: SeaMonkey Suite
component.summary: Web browser, e-mail, news, IRC client, HTML editor

description.p: SeaMonkey is an all-in-one Internet application suite and the direct successor to the former popular Netscape Communicator and Mozilla Application suite. It includes an Internet browser, advanced e-mail, newsgroup and feed client, a calendar, IRC client, HTML editor and a tool to inspect the DOM for web pages.

SeaMonkey historically shares a common codebase with Mozilla's Firefox browser and the Thunderbird email application. The current releases are now developed primarily by porting (step by step) modern code into an older codebase (branched since Firefox 56), thereby preserving old-school/classic user preferences in interface, features and behaviour. The codebase is also updated upstream for a possible later release using the latest mozilla codebase.

However, due to manpower shortage, the development is a bit slow for now and many overly modern sites don't work with SeaMonkey properly. But other suite components, such as email client, are quite usable today and the development team is comitted to update the codebase so that the latest web features are supported again.
